items.t: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Stock Looks Below Fair Value Following A 41% Run
items.sum: Bristol-Myers Squibb has quietly turned in a strong share price run over the past few years, helped by fresh data for key therapies and a solid pipeline story. With the stock around US$62.91 at the last close, the real question for you is whether that level is backed up by the cash the business can generate over time. items.t: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Reports 56 Week Pediatric Phase 3 Camzyos Data
items.sum: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) reported new 56-week Phase 3 data for Camzyos in pediatric obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The updated results show sustained efficacy over 56 weeks in children with symptomatic oHCM who were previously treated in shorter-term studies. items.t: How to Use the Years Between 62 and 75 to Turn a $1.05 Million IRA Into $5,100 a Month Tax-Free
items.sum: When the paychecks stop at 62 and Social Security can wait, a short stretch of near-zero income opens a tax window most retirees never notice. Miss it, and the IRS decides how much you withdraw at 75.

items.t: A Record-High Dividend Yield Can Be a Warning Sign. Just Ask Pfizer
items.sum: A huge yield looks like a bargain until the payout gets cut. Six dividend stocks just hit record yields against their own history, and only some of them can afford what they pay shareholders.
